policy.layout: One long page per course; cards link directly to existing demos and public student handouts.
policy.urls: Keep all demo URLs and QR codes unchanged.
policy.keys: Instructor guides and answers remain private in PhysicsSteven/TeacherKeys.
policy.scope: Required Physics I and II first; basic optics optional; other material later.

status_meanings.usable: Existing activity can be surfaced in this role; not a release certification or full-section coverage claim.
status_meanings.needs-handout: Existing lab apparatus needs a current textbook-aligned student handout and private guide.
status_meanings.needs-feature: A required feature or topic is absent/partial; see note.
status_meanings.missing: No mapped activity exists for this section.

policy.section_status: Section status describes scoped topic coverage through demos and/or standalone activities. Demo and activity statuses describe their packages; usable does not mean full-section mastery or release certification.
policy.later_mapping: beyond_book means no direct Volume 1/2 activity home, not that the demo is physically incorrect. Later entries are not promoted into courses merely because a section is related.
policy.optional_duration: duration_minutes may be added after review; absent until estimated.
policy.exam_metadata: Course metadata may later hold exam_boundaries; omitted for now.
policy.activities: Optional activities array contains standalone worksheet/reading resources, distinct from the real-demo catalog. Sections reference activities by id; render both section.demos and section.activities, filtering course membership and deduplicating within a unit.

sections.title: Electrical Current

sections.title: Model of Conduction in Metals
sections.note: Resistivity of a Wire, Inside the wire (reviewed 2026-10-23, Claude): v_d = I/(nqA), J = I/A = nqv_d, electrons per second, transit time, Fermi speed and Drude collision time. Covers the section's drift velocity and current density. The demo's gauges are thin lab wires (up to 1 A), so OpenStax Example 9.3 (12 gauge, 20 A) is a calculation, not a setting; copper n = 8.47e28 m^-3 (Ashcroft and Mermin) versus the book's 8.34e28.

sections.title: Resistivity and Resistance
sections.note: Resistivity of a Wire: R = ρL/A with length, gauge, material and temperature; ρ and α from fits. Circuits for Ohm's law in circuits.

sections.title: Superconductors
